options.title: Building entrance
options.description: Physical entrance through which a user enters a building or facility.

options.title: Park or compound gate
options.description: Gate or opening providing access to a park, campus or other compound.

options.title: Public transport stop
options.description: Street-level boarding or alighting point for a scheduled public transport service.

options.title: Platform
options.description: Boarding area associated with one or more public transport services, usually within a stop area or station.

options.title: Station entrance
options.description: Street-level entrance providing access to a station complex and its platforms or services.

options.title: Ferry terminal access
options.description: Access point leading to a ferry terminal, pier or boarding area.

options.title: Taxi rank or pickup point
options.description: Fixed or designated location where users access a taxi, ride or pickup service.

options.title: Shared-mobility dock or pickup point
options.description: Dock, station or designated location for picking up or returning shared vehicles.

options.title: Parking entrance
options.description: Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a parking facility.

options.title: Virtual DRT stop
options.description: Designated non-physical or lightly marked pickup or drop-off location for demand-responsive transport.

options.title: Mobility-hub access
options.description: Entrance or access node to a multimodal mobility hub or interchange.

options.title: General access node
options.description: Generic access interface used when no more specific access-point type applies.
